name: Macro Distribution Granularity
definition: A parameter classifying data distribution by the minimum redistribution quantum. Coarse granularity implies a node sends all or none of its data. Fine granularity allows any number of arbitrarily connected samples. Medium granularity implies data is transmitted in fixed-size chunks (macros).
summary: Macro distribution granularity partitions volume rendering data into fixed-size chunks to balance addressing overhead and communication waste, distinct from spatial arrangement or redundancy strategies.
